facts.fact: CNIAPGE began on 15 July 2025 a 10-day training for more than 50 Primatura officials on the GEX case-file platform, to be extended to ministerial departments.

GNQ.note: GEX is an internal case-file platform, not a service people use online.

facts.fact: The article says the GEX case-file platform was developed by CNIAPGE's own technical team, and CNIAPGE's Deploy department staff run its training for the Prime Minister's office.
CNIAPGE, the national centre for computerising public administration, is rolling GEX out to the Primatura at the Prime Minister's request, with ministerial departments to follow.
